children.innerHTML: hex is an incremental build tool for monorepos. It rebuilds only what changed, caches the rest, and never asks you to read a YAML novel.
Content-hash everything, walk the graph, skip the rest. 90%+ cache hits on real repos.
One teammate builds it, nobody builds it again. CI included, no extra service to run.
Your build file is code: typed, testable, and refactorable like everything else.
The daemon holds the graph in memory. Saves feel like hot reload, because they are.
Every target can tell you exactly which file, env var or flag made it dirty.
Imports your existing make, turbo or bazel setup. Exports plain scripts if you ever quit.
Median cold and warm build times across three public monorepos, measured on the same runner. Benchmarks repo is public; bring your own stopwatch.
